title: Ignore trimmer deletions of clauses the proof never added
summary: The native proof trimmer no longer records deletions of clauses it never added, so it stops reviving phantom clauses in its backward pass and crashing with an internal error. The z3test LassoRanker QF_LRA log that previously fell back to a 29 MB untrimmed replay now trims, exports in 26 s and checks in Lean in under two minutes.
